openwrt_wiki.Installation: Installation via EVA: In the first seconds after Power is connected, the bootloader will listen for FTP connections on 192.168.178.1. ftp> quote USER adam2 / quote PASS adam2 / binary / debug / passive / quote MEDIA FLSH / put openwrt-sysupgrade.bin mtd1. Note that this procedure might take up to two minutes. You need to powercycle the Device afterwards to boot OpenWrt. Alternatively you can use this script (Python) ... https://fritz-tools.readthedocs.io/en/latest/
openwrt_wiki.Recovery Tool: AVM provides a recovery tool for Windows: https://download.avm.de/fritzwlan/fritzwlan-repeater-450e/other/recover/

gluon_pr_1506.Text: This adds the AVM FRITZ!WLAN Repeater 450E. (QCA9556/16M/64M). The two patches are needed to circumvent the SOCs hardware bug ... Personally i think these devices are perfectly fine (although i wouldn't pick them as "recommended") as people tend to have these kind of devices lying around. Hardware wise, except for the RSSI LEDs everything is working fine (WPS button, other LEDs, ethernet, wifi).
